transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Ticked when this line is sold surfaced (planed) rather than rough. ARCH remanufacturing is a SERVICE with a fee, not the Industriel kind: no new SKU and no inventory adjustment. The fee is not charged to the customer - the trader folds it into the selling price, and MGSL post a journal entry at invoicing so it lands on the profitability report (Marc-Antoine Poirier, 2026-08-21).
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Tick this when the customer is taking this line planed. Enter the target dressed thickness alongside. Costed per board foot, and cutting is charged separately at the same rate, so a line that is both planed and cut carries both fees.
